items.description: Translation from Spanish to English, 68 lines
items.rationale: Translating the police report is a claim substantiation cost, excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) and named as such in 11.2.
Working material raised alongside the translation charge is excluded by 7.1.8(e) and (f).

items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Robbery under threat of a weapon is covered under 2.3.1. The expensive watch (a Tudor Royal, likely above EUR 2,500) is capped at the EUR 2,500 per-item valuables sub-limit under 4.2.2, and the cash of over EUR 800 at the EUR 500 means-of-payment sub-limit under 4.2.3. The total of 3,000 stays within the EUR 5,000 away-from-premises limit; less the EUR 50 deductible, this gives 2,950.
Forwarding and carriage charges are excluded by 7.1.8(b) and 5.2.3.
